resources.string: Catch every fish in the deep. This short tour shows how to play and what everything does. Tap Next, or Skip tour if you already know your way around.
The bar at the bottom takes you everywhere: Fish is where you cast, the Dex collects every species you meet, the Shop has rope upgrades, tackle and looks for your boat, and Battle is for 1v1 matches.
The big Cast line button at the bottom of the Fish tab drops your hook from the boat.
During a cast, drag left and right anywhere on the screen. A ring shows where your finger is: the hook glides over to it and follows it. Rope Agility makes it faster.

The hook sinks until it has bumped %1$d times or reaches the end of the rope, then it turns back up. On a fish, only the head counts as a bump (the same spot you aim for on the way up); brushing a body or tail is free. Rocks, driftwood and jellies count wherever you touch them. The first %2$d m are bump-free.
On the way up, steer so the hook meets a fish\'s head: the pale face by its eye. Touching the tail or body does nothing.
Your rope can only carry so much. Watch the Load bar: once it\'s full, heavier fish slip away.

As soon as you\'ve used your %1$d bumps, or once nothing more can fit on your line, a Reel in fast button appears on the way up: it hauls the hook to the boat in %2$s seconds at most, wherever you are. Nothing more is caught after that. Handy against the clock in timed battles.

The palette button at the top changes how the menus look: the Lagoon by default, with a sea scene behind every tab. More themes are in the Shop for euros or points, and the richer ones cost more. The water you fish in never changes.
Every theme has a night version: choose Day, Night, or follow your phone\'s dark mode.
Deeper catches are worth more points, shown here at the top. Sparkling fish (gold outline and glints) are worth %1$d× more.

Spend points in the Shop tab, on its Rope page. Rope Length lets you reach deeper zones and new fish, Rope Strength carries more weight, and Rope Agility steers faster. Changed your mind? Downgrade a level and get back every point it cost.

The Tackle page sells one-cast items to switch on before you cast. Lanterns light the dark, a Rare fish detector marks species you haven\'t caught yet within %1$d m of the hook, a Lucky charm gives one extra bump on the way down, and a Sparkle lure brings %2$d× as many Sparkling fish. Prices grow with your rope\'s reach.

Everything in the shop has two prices: euros, or points. A points price is about %1$d minutes of fishing per euro at your rope\'s reach (%2$s for Lantern packs), so paying only saves time: everything can be earned by playing. Paying with points asks you to confirm first.

Below %1$d m the water is dark. Switch this on before a cast to light up much more water around the hook (%2$d m instead of %3$d m). One Lantern is used per cast; earn more from milestones or buy them in the Shop.

%1$d species live in %2$d depth zones, some of them rare, and each has a numbered card. A fish that swims close to your hook is marked as Seen: you learn its name and depths. Catch it to fill its card with its weight, points and your records.
Filter the cards by depth zone, or show only the fish you\'ve caught. Tap a card to open its page, then swipe to flip through the Dex.
Every point you earn counts towards milestone rewards (bonus points and Lanterns), even after you spend it. The trophy at the top of the Fish tab opens them, with a badge when one is ready to claim.

Some tricks are only found by playing, and they pay off: every time you pull one off it adds a bonus to the cast, in battles too. The first time, it\'s explained on the spot and earns a discovery reward, and a Secrets section appears in the Dex. The rarest secrets also unlock Skins for your hook, line, boat and bubble trail, plus a title shown under your name, in online battles too. They\'re made to show off: looks only, never an advantage.

Tap your boat at the top of the Fish tab to open the Skins section of the Dex. Customise boat lets you paint the hull, trim and cabin, and add a pattern, sails, a flag and an emblem. Basic colours are free; the rest unlock with points, or as you catch more species, reach new zones and claim milestones.
The Style page has premade boats, paints, emblems and sail prints (previewed on your own boat), and new hooks, lines and trails. Like every skin, they only change the look, never the game.
The fish you\'ve caught swim in your aquarium: open it with the Aquarium button in the Dex and pick who swims there. Decor and a bigger tank are on the Shop\'s Aquarium page.

Each season lasts %1$s. Every solo cast earns season XP and opens tiers of rewards: tackle and points for everyone, and more (a season boat, a badge) with the season pass. Every weekend also brings a fishing goal with its own reward. None of it changes battles.

The Captain\'s Club is a monthly membership: a members-only paint, a club title badge, cloud save and a free Lantern pouch every month. New anglers also get a one-time Starter pack offer for a few days. A dot on the Shop tab means something is waiting for you there.
Choose the frame of your title badge (shown under your name, online too) and how the Dex shows the species you\'ve caught. More come from the Shop, season passes and events.

The water is harmless near the surface and gets spookier the deeper you go. Reach the Abyssal Floor to unlock Nightmare, a frightening look for the deep: you see exactly as much as before, only the mood changes.
Pick a mode: Best of 5, 3-Minute Rush, Heavy Haul, Species Hunt or Deep Dive. Both players fish the very same water, so skill decides.

Play the computer (Easy, Normal or Hard), a friend on this phone, or someone online: create a room and share its code, or use Quick match. Online, both players use the same tournament rope (level %1$d in every stat).

Lanterns and Rare fish detectors work in battles too: switch them on here, and each of your casts uses one. Anyone can get them, so they\'re part of the game. The Lucky charm and the Sparkle lure are for solo casts only.

After an online battle you can send your opponent a gift: tackle or looks, paid with euros or points. Gifts for you arrive when you open the game. Captain\'s Club members are backed up on the server: the Shop\'s Account button shows the recovery code that restores it on a new phone.
Against the computer you can stake points on the result: a win pays the stake back %1$s× against Easy, %2$s× against Normal and %3$s× against Hard. A draw refunds it.
The gear at the top of the Fish tab opens Settings.

Set the volume, the music and the sound effects separately here. The music follows your hook: calm near the surface, darker in the deep. Vibration adds a light touch to bumps, catches and big wins, and Reduce motion turns off screen shake, slow motion and flashes.

Claim a reward here once a day: points and tackle, and a bigger one every %1$s. Missing a day never sets the calendar back. Your streak counts the days in a row, and a streak shield covers a missed day by itself: you start with %2$d, and every %1$s bring another (up to %3$d).

Every day brings three challenges, easy, medium and hard, matched to your rope, for tackle and points. Don\'t fancy one? Swap it for free (%1$s). Only solo casts count. New ones come at midnight, and finished ones are collected for you if you forget.

Every week, for %1$s, two less common species migrate: one near the surface and one in the deep, both far more common where they live. A banner shows them on the Fish tab and in the Dex. Migrations are for solo casts: battles never change.
Want a nudge when your daily reward is ready, your streak is about to end or a migration starts? Turn reminders on in Settings: at most one a day, and never between %1$s and %2$s.
Friends, the weekly leaderboards and the weekly tournament open from here. Everything there is fished on the standard rope of online battles (level %1$d in every stat), so skill is what counts.
Your player id is your friend code: share it so friends can add you. Nobody can find you by name, and strangers on the leaderboards only see a name made from your id.

Type a friend\'s player id to send a request: you\'re friends once they accept. Their cards show whether they\'re online and their best catches of the week, and Challenge invites them into an online battle room.

Three boards, best cast, deepest catch and rarest catch, for everyone, your league of about %1$d anglers, or your friends. Only casts the server checks itself count: the weekly tournament and online battles. Every board resets on Monday at 00:00 UTC.

All week, everyone fishes the very same water with %1$d bumps. You get %2$d attempts and your best one counts; starting an attempt uses it. When the week ends, rewards go by your final rank, and the top %3$d%% win the Tournament title badge.
Join a club with its code, or start one with a name made from fishing words. Up to %1$d anglers fish for a weekly goal together, and everyone who helped gets each reward reached. There\'s no chat.

Usage statistics and crash reports are only sent if you allow them. Change your mind at any time with the two switches in Settings, under Privacy. That\'s also where you can delete your online account and read the privacy policy.
Deep Line speaks English, French, Spanish, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Turkish. Pick one here, or keep your phone\'s language.
You can replay this tour any time from Settings.
